params.body:
Carries a migration: `2026_09_15_200000_create_webhook_deliveries_table` (Forge runs `migrate --force` on deploy).

## What changes for the administrator

Settings → Koppelingen now shows, below the VWE and Nederland Mobiel credential rows (still "ingesteld / niet ingesteld", never the value), the live state of every integration. Only for the platform administrator (role beheerder plus the `vwe` right); a dealer with the settings right sees the credential rows and nothing else, and a direct Livewire request from anyone else is a 403.

- **Per service** (db, storage, photos backlog, HEIC, mail, RealGarant, FlexLease, Blurit, remove.bg with credits, Car-Pass, Mollie, VWE, OpenAI): the last result of the smoke checks as a status chip (in orde / fout / staat uit), the sentence the check produced, the duration and the moment; "laatst gecontroleerd" top right.
- **Nu controleren** dispatches `RunIntegrationChecks` (the free round only: never `--spend-tokens`, never WhatsApp, never a test mail); the pane polls every 4 s until the job clears the running flag (the flag itself expires after 15 minutes). Outside production the queue is sync, so the round runs inside the request; `IntegrationChecks::run` therefore sets the dealer's user with `setUser` and restores the previous user afterwards, instead of `Auth::login`.
- **Webhook receivers**: global first, then per dealer, with method, host, the ticked events (none ticked = inactive) and the last delivery: HTTP status or "geen antwoord" with the error, duration, moment. Falls back to the newest `webhook_logs` row (one grouped query per 15 minutes; that table has no index) and otherwise says no delivery is recorded yet.
- **Wachtrij**: pending jobs per queue with the oldest, today's failed jobs with the first exception line, and "Opnieuw proberen" per job (`queue:retry <id>` via Artisan).
- **Omgeving** (read only): env (with "verzegeld"), debug, queue connection, mailer + host, `OUTBOUND_ALLOW`/`OUTBOUND_IMPACT` ("niet van toepassing (productie)" on production), Car-Pass environment + host, Mollie live/test, remove.bg balance from the last check, PHP/Laravel, release commit via `BuildStamp`.

## How

- `App\Support\IntegrationChecks` holds the checks and returns structured results (`service, state, text, ms, checkedAt`). `stocklist:smoke` is now a presenter over it: same lines, same exit code, `IntegrationSmokeTest` unchanged and green. Every run (command, schedule, button) stores its outcome per service in **the cache**, key `integration_smoke.last`, `Cache::forever`. Cache and not a table on purpose: it is a snapshot replaced daily and on every button press, no history is needed, and after a `cache:clear` it is simply measured again by the 06:30 run or the button.
- `webhook_deliveries` (webhook_id, vehicle_id, type, status_code, duration_ms, error, created_at; indexed on webhook_id+created_at) is written in `WebhookHelper::deliver`, the one place a message leaves, so `SendVehicleWebhookJob` and the direct path both leave a row; `webhook_logs` keeps the full bodies as before. A failing insert is logged and never blocks the delivery. `WebhookDelivery` is `MassPrunable` (30 days), pruned by `model:prune` daily at 06:40.
- Schedule: `stocklist:smoke --all` moves from 07:10 to 06:30 (pinned in `ScheduleTest`, together with the prune line).
- PR 405 re-applied (its merge commit carried no diff): `zegel niet van toepassing (productie)` on production for Car-Pass, plus the two tests; Mollie and WhatsApp only name `OUTBOUND_IMPACT` in a branch that is unreachable on production, pinned by test.
- Rules: new section **P3-13 Koppelingen: wat de beheerder ziet** (R P3-13.1 to P3-13.5) in `docs/bedrijfsregels/33-p3-integraties.md`, tests tagged.
- New `ui-status-*` classes in `refresh.css`; rows are 44 px on phones, the meta moves under the name. Translations in nl/en/fr/de (`integrations.php`).

## Tests

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'IntegrationSmoke|Integration|Webhook|Schedule|Settings|Queue|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|LanguageParity|VehiclePublishing'`: 183 tests, 1581 assertions, green (1 pre-existing incomplete: Spanish gaps). New: `IntegrationStatusTest` (admin 200 and sees the state, dealer sees no state, direct request 403, check-now dispatches once and marks running, job stores and clears the flag, webhook rows, failed jobs + retry through a mocked Artisan, environment without secrets, production wording), `WebhookDeliveryTest` (row written by the job under `Http::fake()`, error row, prune boundary), `IntegrationSmokeTest` (+ PR 405 tests, structured results, cache write per service, logged-in user restored), `ScheduleTest` (06:30 smoke, 06:40 prune).

Screenshots at 1440 and 390 in `.playwright-mcp/admin-integrations/` of the worktree. Verified live on a local server: the button runs the round synchronously and the admin stays logged in as the admin; retry shows the notice.

## Open points

- The `webhook_logs` fallback is a grouped scan of a 330k-row table without an index, cached 15 minutes; if it proves slow on production the cache period can grow or the fallback can go.
- A deploy that runs `cache:clear` empties `integration_smoke.last`; the pane then says "nog niet gecontroleerd" until 06:30 or a button press. Said so in the code and in R P3-13.1.
params.title: Koppelingen: the admin sees the live state of every integration
